column3: It most closely gathers the focus sequence: spread earth, cast stabilizers, and every beautiful pair grown in it.
It directly explains the mountains as preventing the earth's sway and adds routes and rivers on the stable ground.
It pairs a prepared earth with rain from heaven producing diverse plant pairs, clarifying the focus's life-supporting sequence.
It repeats the anti-sway function of the mountains and adds passes for guided movement, but largely overlaps the preceding parallel.
The immediate sequel turns the described heavens, earth, life, and growth into evidence of God's exclusive creating.
It exactly repeats the earth bringing forth every noble pair and presents this abundant growth as a visible sign.
It joins creation of heavens and earth, descending water, and flourishing gardens to the question of whether any god is alongside God.
It shows that acknowledgment of God as creator of heavens and earth does not necessarily yield understanding.
It links extended earth, stabilizing mountains, and measured growth, though its wording substantially overlaps the first card.
It adds rivers and paired fruits to the stable earth, framing the coordinated order as signs for reflection.
The protected sky offers a limited counterpart to the focus's heavens without visible supports.
It extends the focus's dispersed creatures by placing all creatures and the heavenly beings within universal submission.
It assembles creation, rain-revived earth, and dispersed creatures as interconnected signs for those who reason.
Divine ownership of heaven and earth broadly grounds the created order but adds no detail to its sequence.
The realized threatened event does not clarify the focus's creation, stabilization, or growth signs.
Measured rain settling in the earth supplies a useful intermediate stage before the focus's resulting growth.
Crops and noble dwelling share the vocabulary of noble growth but occur in a different narrative setting.
Revelation's descent is not the focus's material descent of rain and growth.
Blessed water from heaven producing gardens and harvest makes the focus's water-to-growth relation concrete.
Prayer, almsgiving, and certainty in the Hereafter do not illuminate the creation sequence.
The destruction scene and its call to see do not add to the focus's natural signs.
It closely parallels creation of heavens and earth with creatures dispersed through them, adding their eventual gathering.
Descent of tranquility and heavenly forces is a different use of descent from the focus's rain.
The requested heavenly table is not a parallel to the focus's natural water and growth.
Growing grain is a narrow instance of the focus's broad noble paired growth.
Guidance and mercy for doers of good do not explain the focus's signs of creation.
The ship's course and mooring offer only a remote analogy to stability.
Its heavens raised without visible pillars is a near-verbatim counterpart to the focus's opening and adds ordered celestial motion.
Rain reviving a dead land shows the life-giving outcome of the preceding water-to-growth pattern.
It makes human creation and the spreading of creatures signs, directly extending one component of the focus.
Rain stirring dormant earth into every beautiful pair develops the focus's growth into a sign of resurrection.
The reward of believers does not clarify the creation and growth sequence.
The mention of pillars is architectural and does not explain the focus's heavens without visible pillars.
Purifying water sent from heaven is a concise antecedent to the focus's rain and vegetation.
The declaration of guidance and success does not add to the focus's natural signs.
The choice of who casts first is unrelated to the focus's cast mountains or growth.
Abundant poured water gives a focused parallel for rain's descent, but does not include its earthly result.
Punitive rain is a contrary function and does not clarify the life-giving rain in the focus.
The extended pillars of confinement do not illuminate the heavens without visible supports.
It combines high mountains with drinkable water, adding a concrete provision linked to the focus's stabilizing earth.
God's ability to bring forth even a hidden seed from rock, heaven, or earth complements the focus's hidden generative order.
Variety among people and animals loosely complements the focus's varied creatures and noble pairs.
The nearby appeal to what is subjected in heavens and earth and to visible and hidden favors frames the focus as evidence of provision.
Its contrast between following revelation and inherited practice has little direct bearing on the natural sequence.
The spread carpets do not add interpretive value beyond a remote lexical echo of dispersal.
The threat that the earth may begin to sway makes the focus's anti-sway stabilization more salient.
Rain turning the earth green provides a concise visible outcome of the focus's descending water.
It broadens the focus's pairs beyond what the earth grows to all created pairings, including unknown kinds.
The descent of legal verses is not the material rain-and-growth descent in the focus.
Misleading speech and ignorance do not clarify the focus's creation signs.
The possibility of water withdrawing from reach underscores dependence on the heavenly water in the focus.
Creation of every creature from water adds a broad life-source connection but not the focus's sequence.
The abandoned luxury does not clarify noble paired growth.
It names the creator of earth and high heavens, but its revelation context adds little to the focus.
The legal replacement of one spouse by another is not the focus's created pairs.
The parental and association command does not illuminate the natural signs of the focus.
Descent of tranquility and unseen forces is unrelated to rain, earth, and growth.
The convulsion of the Last Day does not clarify the focus's stabilizing mountains.
It joins originating and renewing creation with provision from heaven and earth, reinforcing the focus's exclusive divine agency.
Pairing wrongdoers with what they worship does not clarify created plant pairs.
A pair becoming many people is only a distant generative parallel to the focus's paired growth and scattered creatures.
The firm handhold offers a figurative stability theme but not the focus's physical creation sequence.
The heart's truthful vision does not clarify the focus's visible natural signs.
The sea voyage and divine favor do not add to the focus's earth, rain, or life sequence.
Brief enjoyment followed by punishment is unrelated to the focus.
The Quran's descent is not the rain-induced growth described in the focus.
The magicians being cast down in prostration does not clarify cast mountains.
Praise of the Lord's majestic and generous name adds no specific interpretive parallel.
Scattered people on the Last Day contrast only remotely with creatures dispersed across the earth.
Distributed springs, provision, and tribes offer a broad supply-and-dispersal pattern, but not the focus's natural sequence.
It traces rain through underground springs into varied crops, substantially developing the focus's water-to-diverse-growth process.
Divine kingship and the noble throne do not clarify noble plant pairs.
Arguing about God without knowledge offers only a contextual contrast to reading creation as signs.
The seven paths above and attentive creation lightly complement the focus's heaven-and-earth frame.
Created male and female pairs provide a distinct but limited counterpart to the focus's pairs.
The requested table from heaven is not a useful parallel to life-giving rain.
God's knowledge of all in heavens and earth broadly frames the focus's created order without adding detail.
The Quran's descent from the Lord of worlds is not the focus's material descent.
Settlement in earth and later gathering do not clarify the focus's creation signs.
The call to confront a wrongdoing people is unrelated to the focus.
Seeing one's smallest evil deed does not clarify the focus's created life and growth.
The description of shade as neither cool nor noble does not illuminate noble plant pairs.
Rain sent after despair and mercy spread through it reinforce the beneficial function of the focus's heavenly water.
Mary's good upbringing uses growth figuratively and provision concretely, but does not add to the natural sequence.
Ungrounded rejoicing on earth does not clarify the focus.
The divine attributes alone add no specific connection to the focus's sequence.
Casting Moses' staff is unrelated to the focus's cast stabilizing mountains.
The description of the Quran as noble shares only the adjective with noble pairs.
General clarification, guidance, and admonition do not explain the focus's natural signs.
The objection demanding an angel's descent does not clarify the descent of rain.
Earthly empowerment and means do not add to the focus's creation, stability, or growth.
Seeing one's smallest good deed does not clarify the focus's visible natural signs.
The vision and cursed tree as a trial do not clarify the focus's material creation sequence.
The response to known signs in Joseph's story does not add to the focus's natural signs.
The earth as a containing receptacle offers a limited complement to its role as the field of life and growth.
Vegetation turned yellow by wind supplies a contrasting later state of the growth the focus describes.
The descent of security amid battle is unrelated to the focus's rain and growth.
The descent of a reminder is not a useful parallel to the focus's material descent.
The resurrection objection from decayed bones does not clarify the focus's creation sequence.
The angels' descent upon the steadfast is unrelated to the focus's rain, earth, and living growth.
It directly combines a settled earth, rivers, firm mountains, and a barrier between waters, closely extending the focus's ordered terrestrial setting.
The earth as a resting place supplies a direct counterpart to the focus's prepared and stabilized ground.
It concisely identifies mountains as pegs, directly reinforcing their stabilizing function in the focus.
Abundant pouring water is followed in its immediate sequence by grain, vegetation, and gardens, closely matching the focus's rain-to-growth movement.
It explicitly states that the mountains were firmly set, directly paralleling the focus's casting of stabilizers into the earth.
The resulting water and pasture complete a closely related provision sequence after earth's formation and mountain setting.
Poured water begins a compact sequence that continues with earth split open and diverse food grown, closely clarifying the focus's causal order.
The splitting of earth offers a concrete intermediate action between rain and the vegetation named in the focus.
Its grain is a specific product of the focus's broad noble paired growth.
The passage explicitly frames the grown produce as provision for people and their livestock, clarifying the life-sustaining result.
Water sent down from heaven is directly described as the source of drink and pasture, a close counterpart to the focus's descending water.
It explicitly says that rain grows crops, olives, palms, grapes, and every kind of fruit, developing the focus's diverse growth.
It traces water from heaven through green growth, grain, gardens, and varied fruits, closely expanding the focus's generative sequence.
Rain revives a dead land and brings forth every kind of fruit, making the focus's water and diverse growth a sign of restoration.
It joins creation of heavens and earth with rain from heaven that brings forth fruits as provision, closely matching the focus's opening and closing movements.
It makes water the basis of every living thing, giving a foundational counterpart to the focus's rain, creatures, and growth.
It states that heavenly water gives life to dead land and provides drink for many creatures, directly joining two central focus elements.
The descent of water and its revival of earth after death closely restates the focus's life-giving rain in sign form.
Water from heaven producing fruits of varied colors extends the focus's diverse and noble vegetal output.
The dead earth revived and made to produce grain is a compact parallel for the focus's earth receiving life and growth.
Water sent down in due measure revives a dead land, providing a closely matched measured descent and earthly result.
The earth being spread out directly complements the focus's constructed terrestrial field for mountains, creatures, and growth.
The earth laid out for creatures directly complements the focus's scattering of every creature upon it.
The seven heavens arranged in layers offer a direct cosmological counterpart to the focus's created heavens.
The earth made a wide expanse complements the focus's stable, habitable ground.
The earth being spread out supplies a concise parallel to the focus's ordered terrestrial setting.
God's bringing the living from the dead and the dead from the living gives a broad generative frame for vegetation emerging from rain-fed earth.
Establishing people on earth and providing livelihoods complements the focus's presentation of earth as a habitable, provision-bearing field.
Rain mingling with earth's vegetation until it becomes abundant gives a detailed counterpart to the focus's water-to-growth transformation.
The promise of repeated rain and added strength connects heavenly water with renewed communal vitality, though less directly than the growth passages.
Adjacent lands, gardens, crops, palms, and differing fruits under one water develop the focus's ordered diversity of earthly growth.
Winds as fertilizing agents followed by water sent from heaven add an upstream stage to the focus's rain-and-growth sequence.
Rain reviving earth after death restates the life-giving movement of the focus in a compact form.
Rain from heaven causing mingled earth vegetation offers a vivid but transient counterpart to the focus's growth process.
Water from heaven yielding gardens of palms and vines specifies a cultivated result of the focus's broad vegetation.
The gathering and layering of clouds before rain supplies an atmospheric antecedent to the focus's descending water.
The acknowledgment that God sends water from heaven and revives earth directly parallels the focus's divine agency in rain and growth.
Water driven to barren land to produce crops eaten by people and livestock closely develops the focus's provision-bearing growth.
The earth made a stable place and the sky a structure closely complements the focus's paired terrestrial stability and heavens.
Mountains placed on earth, blessing in it, and measured provisions form a close counterpart to the focus's stabilizers and life-supporting order.
The lifeless earth stirring and swelling after water descends directly mirrors the focus's rain-induced emergence of growth.
The earth made a cradle and paths placed through it closely extend the focus's inhabitable, ordered ground.
Creation of heavens and earth as signs gives a broad framing parallel to the focus's opening claim.
The question of who sends down drinking water highlights the divine source and dependence implicit in the focus's rain.
The earth made tractable for travel and provision complements the focus's stabilized, life-bearing terrestrial setting.
The earth that splits open supplies a concise physical counterpart to the emergence of vegetation from it.
Pasture brought forth gives a compact instance of the focus's earth producing life.
